name: Tweedie

attributes.attribute: a minor water spirit of the Tweed River

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Tweedie is a minor spirit in Scottish folklore. It was the child of a water demon that lived in the Tweed River. The Tweed runs through the Border country of southern Scotland. As a water spirit, Tweedie belonged to the natural world that the people of the Borders knew well.

okr.objective: Record the Scottish water spirit Tweedie.
key_results: Name Tweedie as a minor water spirit of Scottish folklore
Note that it was the child of a water demon in the Tweed River
